text:
Mika Johnson: Morning folks 44b I'm Mika, joining as a Product Data Scientist on the recommendations team. Quick intro: ex-consumer analytics, big fan of kombucha brewing and salsa dancing. Day-one questions: where do I request dataset access, who handles GCP project onboarding, and is there a dev laptop available or should I make a hardware ticket? Also curious if anyone wants to pair on a notebook later this week.
Jules (people-ops): welcome Mika!! Sending the onboarding checklist and asset form now. For laptops we have one MacBook M1 quota left this week  reply to the asset ticket in the portal and we'll imaging it. I'll also start your G Suite/Redwood account.
Mika Johnson: thank you! what's the portal link? and is there a standard env setup doc for the data team?
Devon (platform-eng): hey Mika - portal is https://portal.redwood.com/assets. For infra/dev envs check the onboarding repo: https://git.redwood/onboarding/dev-setup (readme has brew + pyenv steps). For GCP access, we use the GCP access request form in the intranet (People Ops approves, then Platform grants). Tag @Devon on the request and i'll expedite.
Anita (prod-manager): hi Mika :wave: excited to have you. Our team does a 10:30 stand on PT days and a 30-min sync Tues/Wed. I'll add you to the #recs channel and grant repo access after you accept the invite. Fun fact question: what's your favorite snack for late-night modeling? :popcorn:
Mika Johnson: love that schedule, thanks Anita. Favorite snack = salted caramel rice cakes (weird, i know). Pairing would be great later this week  Thu afternoon?
Jules (people-ops): asset portal link pasted. Also created a ticket for laptop imaging: TKT-8342. If you prefer to self-provision, we allow personal machines once dev cert is applied (see policy doc).
it-oncall-bot: Account created: mika@redwood.com at 5211113500. Welcome email sent.
Mika Johnson: got the welcome email. I've filled the asset form and requested GCP access (request #GCP-1298) - pinging @Devon to escalate.
Devon (platform-eng): saw it, escalating now. Meanwhile you can request quick BigQuery viewer via the data access flow if you need immediate read-only. Use this snippet to set up gcloud auth:
```
gcloud auth login
gcloud config set project redwood-prod
```
Mika Johnson: perfect, running that now. One last Q: where do I sign up for a buddy? usually there's a buddy program link?
Jules (people-ops): we assign buddies automatically but you can request one; i assigned you to Sam (recs eng) as your buddy. Sam will DM you.
Anita (prod-manager): Woo! We'll do a quick intro call with Sam + me at 3pm PT today. Welcome again Mika :tada:
Mika Johnson: thanks everyone 389 very excited to be here and meet y'all!
